picks.name: Chore Jacket, putty
picks.why: You still own no utility jacket, and this UK-made, logo-free cotton chore coat is 70% off with L in stock. Putty sits in the stone family, so it works tonally over navy or olive. Layer it over the navy raglan with jeans and trainers for photography walks.

picks.name: Regular Fit Stretch Chinos, fawn
picks.why: Chinos are the one piece every formula leans on and you have no new pair yet. Regular fit with stretch, so they move with you and don't cling at the seat or thigh; go 31in leg for a clean break over Docs. At £26 they anchor the office look with a navy knit and boots, or go casual with the raglan and Sambas.

picks.name: Long Fit Raglan Sweatshirt, navy
picks.why: Fills the empty mid-layer slot. The raglan sleeve gives your long arms more reach, and the longer body sits clean at the waist. Plain navy loopback at £52 (was £65): wear it under the chore jacket or with the fawn chinos at the weekend.
